question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

She kept pictures of her parents all ________ the house.
solution:
The correct answer is "**over.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us first understand the usage of the following in the given sentence:
 
 
• **"Over" is used to say that something goes from one side to the other side of something else, or upward and across something. **(ऊपर)

 
 
• Example: The beautiful bird flew over the lake.
 
 
 
 
 
• **In the given sentence, "Over" is the correct preposition to use to indicate that pictures are spread throughout the house.**​
 
• The correct sentence: She kept pictures of her parents all over__ the house.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "About" means "on the subject of" or "connected with." (के बारे में)

 
 
• Example: Example: She was very worried about her father.
 
 
 
• "Through" is used to talk about something from one end or side of something to the other. (के माध्यम से)
 
 
• Example: The sunlight penetrated through the window.
 
 
 
• "Out" is used as a preposition to talk about movement from within somewhere or something. (बाहर)
 
 
• Example: Riya leaned out of the window and waved.
